deploy-bot: Triggering deploy to production - tag v2.4.1 - commit 9f4c2b3
ci-bot: Pre-deploy CI gate running: unit, lint, integration
ci-bot: GATE FAILED: integration-tests (timeout on job service-e2e-07). Logs: https://ci.redwood.example/9f4c2b3
oliver: @ci-bot which test specifically timed out?
ci-bot: integration-tests -> tests/service_e2e/test_workflow.py::TestWorkflow::test_handover timed out after 15m
maya: saw timeouts on the same job in staging earlier today, that might be related
jun: do we want to rollback or hold? it's still pre-prod so we can halt
oliver: Hold the prod deploy. Don't roll back anything live. Let's rerun the failing job with extra debug and increased timeout
maya: queued rerun: `ci run integration-tests --job=service-e2e-07 --retry --env=staging --timeout=30m`
ci-bot: Rerun started by maya (build 1728-rerun)
ci-bot: Rerun finished: FAILED - same timeout, logs unchanged
oliver: ugh. Can someone collect the test VM/container logs and network metrics around the failure window? possible node eviction or transient network issue
sre-oncall: on it. pinging infra -> checking node eviction, kube events, and host oom/killing around 2024-07-05T22:39:xxZ
jun: given the flakiness and the change window tonight (22:00-23:00 UTC), I propose pinning production to v2.4.0 for the release window and delaying v2.4.1 until root cause fixed
oliver: +1 pin to v2.4.0. We should open a rollback/pin PR and notify PMs
maya: I'll draft the release note and update the release channel now
maya: release-note: "Defer v2.4.1 rollout. Production will remain on v2.4.0 for the 22:00 UTC change window due to integration test timeouts observed in CI. Investigation in progress; will reschedule v2.4.1 after root cause identified."
maya: @product @ops FYI :eyes:
ci-bot: Marking deploy: BLOCKED - reason=CI_integration_timeout affected_jobs=[service-e2e-07]
deploy-bot: Aborting deploy for tag v2.4.1 - blocked_by=CI_GATE. Applying pin: production -> v2.4.0 (requested by jun)
oliver: Opening investigation issue and attaching CI logs: https://ci.redwood.example/9f4c2b3/logs
jun: assigning to @oliver and @sre-oncall for triage
sre-oncall: ack. will gather node eviction metrics, pod restart counts, and correlate timestamps
maya: thanks all. plan: hold v2.4.1, pin v2.4.0 for tonight, follow-up with deeper infra debugging tomorrow outside the change window
oliver: quick summary: deploy blocked by CI integration timeout -> rerun failed -> pin to v2.4.0 for change window -> investigation ticket created
ci-bot: Reaction :white_check_mark: to summary
